# gitea_user (Data Source)

Fetches information about a Gitea user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_user" "example" {
  username = "my-user"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `is_admin` (Boolean)
- `language` (String)
- `last_login` (String)
